items.case: Open screen: form, map and list
procedure: Login as IELP Admin (Master screens: every role, decision G-COM-01).
Open menu Master > Location Code.
expected: Form blank in Add Mode; map centred on the default area with marker / radius circle controls.
List of locations with Location Code, Loc Name, Sub Area, Auto Cycle, Cycle To Area, Auto Finish, Coordinates, Radius, addresses, Status; paging.

procedure: Search = "sunter".
Search = "ZZZ".
expected: Rows matching code, name, sub area or addresses.
Msg no.17 (Info): 'No Data Found'

procedure: Click Opsi > View on S1.
expected: Modal with all location fields; Close (x) closes it.

items.case: Add location with map pick and DB
procedure: Location Name = "depo test", Alias = "dt1", Sub Area = DEPO, Radius = 75, Auto Finish = Yes.
Type "Cakung" in Location Address Google Map, pick a suggestion.
Click [Save].
expected: Latitude / Longitude filled (7 decimals), marker and radius circle shown.
Msg no.10 (Info): 'Location DT1 - DEPO TEST has been saved successfully.'

DB (SQL TD-10) ielp.MS_LOCATION: LOCATION_NAME, LOCATION_ALIAS = DT1, LOCATION_LATITUDE / LOCATION_LANGITUDE as text, RADIUS = 75, AUTO_FINISH, STATUS = ACTIVE (DCR-04), VERSION = 1 (DCR-05), CREATED_BY.

items.ref: UISS: 5.3, Msg no.1, Msg no.2, Msg no.4, Msg no.5, Msg no.6, Msg no.7
procedure: Click [Save] with blank form.
Then enter the invalid values of Test Data table A one by one, [Save].
expected: Msg no.1 (Error): 'Mandatory Field Not Entered'
Table A: Msg no.2 (Error): 'Invalid format for Location Alias. The format must be letters / numbers, max 10 characters', Msg no.4, Msg no.5, Msg no.6, Msg no.7 for the related field; nothing saved.

procedure: Add a location with Alias = "S1" (existing).
expected: Msg no.3 (Error): 'Duplication found for Location Alias S1'

items.case: Address not found / map service unavailable
items.ref: UISS: Item 6, Msg no.11, Msg no.12
procedure: Type "xxqqzz" in the address field.
Block the map / geocoding service and open the screen.
expected: Msg no.11 (Info): 'Address not found.'
Msg no.12 (Warning): 'Map service is not available. Please input Latitude and Longitude manually.'; Latitude / Longitude can be typed.

procedure: Opsi > Edit on DT1; Radius = 100; [Save].
expected: Msg no.10 (Info): 'Location DT1 - {Name} has been saved successfully.'
DB (SQL TD-11): RADIUS = 100, VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY / UPDATED_DATE.

items.case: Edit an INACTIVE location / change alias of a used location
procedure: Edit INACTIVE X9 and save.
Edit used S1, change Alias, save.
expected: Msg no.8 (Error): 'Location X9 is INACTIVE and cannot be changed. / Location Alias cannot be changed because the location is used in delivery transactions.'
Alias change rejected (second text of Msg no.8).

items.ref: UISS: Item 41-43, 5.5, Msg no.13, Msg no.16, Log 3
procedure: Opsi > Deactivate on S1 (used in delivery), confirm.
expected: Msg no.13 (Confirm): 'Are you sure you want to deactivate location S1? It will no longer be available for new transactions.'
Msg no.16 (Info): 'Location S1 has been deactivated (INACTIVE). / Location S1 has been deleted.'
DB: STATUS = INACTIVE (DCR-04).

items.ref: UISS: Msg no.14, Msg no.15, Msg no.16, Log 4
procedure: Opsi > Delete on DT1 (never used), confirm.
Try Delete on S1 (used).
expected: Msg no.14 (Confirm): 'Are you sure you want to delete the record ?'
DT1 deleted (IS_DELETE, values TBD).
Msg no.15 (Error): 'Location S1 is used in delivery transactions. Please use Deactivate.'

items.case: Finish outside the radius / auto finish
procedure: Driver closes a delivery 300 m from S1 (radius 75).
Driver arrives inside the radius of a destination with Auto Finish = Yes.
expected: Msg no.18 (Warning): 'Anda melakukan closing delivery di luar radius lokasi tujuan.'
Log no.5 written; ORDER_CYCLE.IS_FINISH_EX_GEOFENCE set (inferred).
Log no.6: delivery finished automatically.

procedure: Users A and B edit DT1; B saves, A saves.
expected: Msg no.9 (Error): 'Error in Update because of concurrency check.'

precondition: IELP Admin; locations S1 (used, ACTIVE), X9 (INACTIVE), DT1 created by the add case.

sql_verify.title: Inserted location
sql_verify.sql:
SELECT LOCATION_NAME, LOCATION_ALIAS, LOCATION_LATITUDE, LOCATION_LANGITUDE, RADIUS, AUTO_FINISH, AUTO_CYCLE, LOCATION_SUB, STATUS, VERSION, CREATED_BY
FROM ielp.MS_LOCATION WHERE LOCATION_ALIAS = 'DT1';

sql_verify.title: Updated location
sql_verify.sql: SELECT RADIUS, STATUS, IS_DELETE, VERSION, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_DATE FROM ielp.MS_LOCATION WHERE LOCATION_ALIAS IN ('DT1', 'S1');
